confidence_rubric.high: Derived from direct counts in an issue tracker or equivalent authoritative ledger.
confidence_rubric.low: Inferred from indirect proxies (force-push detection, label heuristics, keyword matching with > 20% unknown bucket).
confidence_rubric.medium: Approximated from git commit patterns (PR-merge commits, conventional-commit prefixes, commit-on-branch timestamps).

description: Canonical enumeration of the 12 user-specified development-acceleration metrics. Acts as the metrics-endpoint surface for a batch pipeline per AAP Rule 1.

engineering_actor_framing.after: agent@blitzy.com (Blitzy Agent) is the engineering actor; humans review but do not co-author.
engineering_actor_framing.baseline: Human author email is the actor.

metrics.boundary_conditions: Bot-authored PRs are excluded unless head_ref starts with 'blitzy-'.
metrics.definition: Number of in-progress items per phase window. In-progress = branch has at least one commit AND PR is open (not merged, not closed-without-merge), OR PR is in draft state. Exclude PRs from bot accounts other than Blitzy (branches prefixed with blitzy-).
metrics.fallback_data_source: Local git branches with no merge to main
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: GitHub PRs API unavailable AND no local branch state can be derived.
metrics.unit: count of in-progress items (mean over phase windows)

metrics.boundary_conditions: Counts MERGED items only; does not credit work-in-progress.
metrics.definition: Items completed per phase window. Counted as PR-merge commits to main (identifiable by '(#NNNN)' suffix in the commit subject).
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: None expected; git history is always available in a clone.
metrics.primary_data_source: Local git history (git log --format='%H %s' on main)

metrics.boundary_conditions: Requires at least 3 windows in a phase to be meaningful; fewer windows produce 'Insufficient signal'.
metrics.definition: Coefficient of variation (stdev/mean) of Flow Velocity across windows in the phase. Lower = more predictable.

metrics.boundary_conditions: Ready-for-review is the earliest of: (a) PR leaving draft, (b) first review requested, (c) first commit by another author, (d) PR opened.
metrics.definition: Active working time per item from the engineering actor's perspective. Working phases: initial span = first author commit on branch -> ready-for-review event; refine spans = first commit after a review -> last commit before next review or merge. Sum inclusive durations.
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: PR API and git timestamps both unavailable.
metrics.primary_data_source: GitHub PRs API (commit + review timestamps, draft state transitions)
metrics.unit: median active working time per item (hours)

metrics.definition: Flow Active / Flow Time per PR; median across PRs per phase. Review time counts as wait from the actor's perspective.
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: Either Flow Active or Flow Time returns Insufficient signal.
metrics.primary_data_source: Computed from Flow Active and Flow Time

metrics.boundary_conditions: If unknown rate > 20% in either phase, confidence is downgraded to Low for that phase.
metrics.definition: Work-type mix: feature / defect / risk-compliance / tech-debt / unknown. Classification priority: (1) labels on linked issues; (2) PR-title conventional-commit prefix; (3) keyword match; (4) unknown.
metrics.fallback_data_source: PR-title conventional-commit prefix from git log
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: PR titles and labels both lack discernible work-type signal.
metrics.unit: share of merged PRs by work type (percent)

metrics.boundary_conditions: Excludes PRs with rewritten history (first-commit timestamp unrecoverable).
metrics.definition: Median wall-clock from first commit on a PR branch to merge commit on main. Exclude PRs whose first-commit timestamp is unavailable due to history rewrites; report the exclusion rate.
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: Less than 50% of PRs have a recoverable first-commit timestamp.
metrics.primary_data_source: Local git history (first-parent traversal of merge commit branch)

metrics.boundary_conditions: Reverts whose original cannot be identified are excluded as unattributable; reverts whose original is not reachable from any release are excluded as unreleased; reverts of reverts are excluded.
metrics.definition: Production incidents or change failures attributed to releases in the phase. For each revert: (a) identify the original commit being reverted via the 'Reverts commit SHA' reference in the revert message, or by tree-match against a prior commit's parent if no explicit reference is present; (b) identify the most recent release tag T such that T is an ancestor of the original commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor T <original>); (c) attribute the revert to release T.
metrics.fallback_data_source: Revert commits attributed to releases via 'Reverts commit SHA' + git merge-base --is-ancestor
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: No incident-label taxonomy and no revert commits in the phase.

metrics.boundary_conditions: Prereleases excluded from primary count; reported separately.
metrics.definition: Releases per phase. Source precedence: (1) GitHub Releases / GitLab Releases API, (2) annotated git tags matching semver pattern v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+, (3) deployment events from CI/CD if accessible. Prerelease tags (matching -alpha, -beta, -rc, -dev suffixes) are excluded from the primary count and reported separately.
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: GitHub Releases API unavailable AND no annotated semver tags exist (this repo has zero annotated tags).

metrics.boundary_conditions: This repository's labeler.yml does not define exception/waiver/override labels; force-push detection from a clone is not reliable.
metrics.definition: Branch protection bypasses, force-pushes to protected branches, and PRs labeled with waiver/exception/override.
metrics.fallback_data_source: Force-push detection from reflog (if available) + label scan
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: No admin audit log access AND no exception labels AND no detectable force-pushes.

metrics.boundary_conditions: GitHub Actions artifact retention is typically 90 days; older history unavailable.
metrics.definition: Per-test passing->failing transitions on main and newly-marked skipped/disabled/xfail tests. Flaky tests counted only if failing in >=3 consecutive runs.
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: Test-result artifacts not retrievable for the phase windows.
metrics.primary_data_source: GitHub Actions Artifacts API (JUnit XML from test.yml, e2e.yml, chromatic.yml)
metrics.unit: count of passing->failing transitions per phase

metrics.boundary_conditions: Formbricks has no SLA source as of this AAP; metric returns Insufficient signal until one is discovered at runtime.
metrics.definition: Bug-labeled issues whose time-to-resolution exceeds the policy SLA. Requires an SLA source: (1) issue tracker SLA field, (2) policy doc in the repository.
metrics.fallback_data_source: Policy document under docs/ specifying SLA tiers
metrics.insufficient_signal_condition: No SLA field on issues AND no policy doc found.
metrics.primary_data_source: Issue tracker SLA field on bug-labeled issues
metrics.unit: count of bug issues breaching SLA per phase

temporal_phases.baseline: Before the detected AI tool introduction date (see acceleration/data/inflection.json).
temporal_phases.fallback: If fewer than six post-introduction windows exist, report Baseline vs Post-Introduction only.
temporal_phases.ramp_up: First six 2-week windows post-introduction (Monday-aligned UTC, 84 days).
temporal_phases.steady_state: Windows seven and later (90+ days post-introduction).
